title: "A3_Readjusted_pval"
output: html_document

## Tasks Performed:

-   Adjusting p-values post ANCOMBC2 (Differential_Abundance_V2.Rmd) for within-group comparisons only for *specific* taxa

-   Remaking plots, annotating significance (p_adj \< 0.05)

```{r Loading libraries and data}

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

control_res_filt <- read.delim("control_res_filt.tsv")
ms_res_filt <- read.delim("ms_res_filt.tsv")
```

```{r p Readjustment}

control_res_adj <- control_res_filt %>% mutate(new_padj = p.adjust(p_GroupHLI, 
                                                method='BH'))

ms_res_adj <- ms_res_filt %>% mutate(new_padj = p.adjust(p_GroupMSLI, 
                                                method='BH'))

```

## Had to stop there...

Upon checking the results post-adjustment, there was still no significance to be found in either group. Therefore, there is no point in generating new plots.
